dict.string: 重新啟動遊戲後生效 · takes effect after relaunching the game

array.string: 自動 · 跟隨系統語言 · Follow system language

dict.string: 開啟：遊戲的底座設定，輸出 1920×1080、內部 1600×900，需要較快的 iPad。關閉：手持 1280×720（內部 960×540）。重新啟動遊戲後生效 · on: the game's docked settings, 1920×1080 output, 1600×900 inside (for a fast iPad). Off: handheld 1280×720 (960×540 inside). Takes effect after relaunching the game
Full HD（底座模式）· Full HD (docked)
鎖 30 幀畫面更穩、手機更涼；遊戲中也可以點觸控按鍵中間的 60 / 30 切換 · 30 is steadier and keeps the phone cooler; the 60 / 30 button between − and + of the touch controls switches it while playing
未連接手柄時使用手機的陀螺儀和觸覺馬達；接上手柄後自動讓位。重新啟動遊戲後生效 · uses the phone's gyro and haptic actuator with no controller connected; a connected controller takes over. Takes effect after relaunching the game
震动与陀螺仪只对支持的手柄生效。体感瞄准同时受游戏内选项影响。重新启动游戏后生效 · rumble and gyro apply only to controllers that have them, and motion aiming is also subject to the game's own option. Takes effect after relaunching
只对带触感的手柄生效；关掉后手机本身的震动也一起关 · applies to controllers with haptics; off also turns the phone's own vibration off
体感瞄准同时受游戏内选项影响 · motion aiming is also subject to the game's own option

把存檔（save 與 game-slot）複製到你選的資料夾，例如「檔案」App 裡自建或共用的資料夾；刪掉 App 之後存檔還在，重裝後選同一個資料夾即可還原。與 Mac ↔ iPhone / iPad 的存檔同步分開：同步用同一個資料夾下的 Saves，這裡用遊戲名稱的子資料夾，兩者不會寫到同一批檔案。重新啟動遊戲後生效 · copies save and game-slot into a folder you pick (for example one in the Files app); they survive deleting the app, and a reinstall restores them from the same folder. Separate from the Mac ↔ iPhone / iPad save sync: that keeps a Saves folder, this keeps a folder named after the game, so the two never write the same files. Takes effect after relaunching the game
自動備份存檔 · Automatic save backup
打開後下一次啟動會請你選一次資料夾 · on: the next launch asks for the folder once
重新選擇備份資料夾 · Choose the backup folder again
下一次啟動重新選一次；選「以後再說」則暫停備份 · the next launch asks again; "Later" pauses the backup
下次啟動匯入存檔 · Import a save on the next launch

下一次啟動先請你選存檔資料夾，確認後匯入；目前的存檔會先保留在 App 的 Documents/save-before-import · the next launch asks for a save folder and copies it in after you confirm; the current save is first kept in the app's Documents/save-before-import

開啟後把日誌寫進 App 的 Documents/log.txt（在 Mac 上讀取），會稍微影響效能；關閉時不記錄任何日誌。重新啟動遊戲後生效 · writes Documents/log.txt for reading on a Mac (slightly slower); off records nothing. Takes effect after relaunching the game
